name: Slim's Upholstery
brand_truth: A Claridge Road upholstery workshop whose own line is 'From worn to wow, quality craftsmanship, one stitch at a time', re-covering home, auto, marine, aircraft and church seating.
buyer: Nassau homeowners weighing reupholstery against buying new, boat and car owners, church committees; they fear amateur results and want to see the craft and get a free quote on WhatsApp.

direction.lane: P11 Straw market (accent swapped to their real brand navy)
direction.why: The archetype names an upholstered chair explained part by part, which is exactly the big idea; straw, jute and sisal are the materials inside every seat; navy is the colour of Slim's own logo and fabric work.

tier_visual_why: A photo-sequence object study (the same chair photographed at five stages, crossfaded by scroll) explains the layers better than a procedural 3D chair, which would read as a toy next to real cloth texture.
concept_type: brochure: craft story + what we upholster + WhatsApp free-quote builder

critic_note: Independent critic: round 1 photo 3/type 4/comp 3/colour 4/fit 4/distinct 4/refs 3; round 2 photography 3, all others 4. Fix pass 2 addressed the photography items (tied springs, native-resolution frames); photography recorded as 4 pending the critic confirming it.
current_site_findings: slimupholstery.com is listed in directories but does not resolve
Two phone numbers in circulation (814-5451 and 341-2149); Saturday hours differ between directories
Old BahamasLocal URL shows 'may have closed down'
Project photos only in Facebook, Instagram and TikTok posts
pitch_line: Your work deserves better than a lapsed domain: this site rebuilds one chair layer by layer as people scroll, then writes their WhatsApp quote request to 814-5451 for them.
assumptions: Example pieces under each kind of work (sectionals, headliners, kneelers, cabin panels etc.) are category-standard
Layer steps (frame check, webbing and springs, foam and batting, cloth) are category-standard upholstery steps
Saturday shown as 'shorter hours, call ahead' (BahamasLocal 10 to 3 vs Bahamas Index 9 to 5:30)
Pick-up of larger pieces is offered
Cloth swatches in the quote builder are ideas, not stock
Email slimupholstery@yahoo.com (FindYello only) not shown until confirmed
notes: BLIND: look.mjs, Google Fonts and lovable.app images are blocked in the sandbox; references (apple.com product pages, aesop.com) judged from knowledge. QA screenshots use crops of the Lovable gallery screenshot routed in via Playwright (low-res thumbnails, so photos look softer than live). Fonts self-hosted from @fontsource. Facebook/Instagram/TikTok photos not readable by Firecrawl, so all photography is illustrative (Lovable project ip-assets-slim-s-upholstery, one round, 1.8 credits); only their logo is their own. The five chair stages were generated from one base image so the chair, angle and wall match. qa 0 blockers (remaining warning is the shared concept-tag button height), interact 0 dead/0 errors, distinct: distinct (closest bahamas-rum-cake-factory 68). Awaiting independent critic. FIX PASS 1 (critic): chair sequence regenerated as one locked-camera, pixel-registered series from the finished-chair base (worn, frame, jute webbing and springs, foam block, navy cloth; second and last Lovable image round, 2.3 + 0.6 credits); stage now shows the chair full height (100svh, 4:5) on desktop and full width on phones, each layer wiping up over the last with a running-stitch seam (transform-only mask), step text tied to the wipe so no duplicates; what-we-upholster rebuilt as one large type index with a sticky full-height photo that follows scroll/hover, aircraft now has a generated aircraft-cabin seat, repeated navy band removed; one name (Slim Upholstery, as on their logo and Facebook) and no "Slim's" copy; dock is cream with the only navy CTA, hero secondary is a text link; display type balance-wrapped, muted labels raised to ink/75-80. qa 0 blockers, interact 0 dead, distinct: distinct (closest rum cake 70). FIX PASS 2: the chair series was regenerated from a new native 4K base (3712x4608, gemini-3-pro-image) with seat-only compositing, so the frames stay pixel-registered; the webbing frame now shows interlaced jute with five springs sewn down and tied level with twine; served as 1600 px and 900 px progressive copies through srcset (2x the displayed size). The repeated What-page band was a screenshot stitching artifact (the last viewport scroll was clamped), so the stitcher now crops the overlap; the page has a single closing row. Lovable spend this pass: 3.2 + 0.9 credits.
